task_type: production performance and media reliability repair
requested_outcome: Remove unusable image-placeholder cards, make public navigation and business pages feel immediate, publish the exact tested release and verify it in production.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co/ plus public search, spa rails and business or event detail pages on desktop and mobile
authorization_boundary: The current request authorizes code changes, tests and one verified public deployment. Supplier writes, bookings, payments, outbound messages and destructive data operations are excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request explicitly requires publication and live proof.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Local checks cannot complete the task; exact public routes must be retested after release.

lesson_bundle.reason: Gallery media and detail loading are shared across several public worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The repair must cover the affected card and detail-page families, not the supplied screenshot alone.

lesson_bundle.reason: Speed must not come from fabricated or stale ad-hoc supplier data.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Public rendering may use only the accepted platform snapshot and must retain truthful fallbacks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The broken card remains visible with a different placeholder.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Withdraw the entire deal card when every real media source fails.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A forced image failure removes the card and no unavailable-image label is rendered.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only warm repeat visits improve while first business-page visits still wait on the supplier.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove live supplier calls from public detail rendering and use the accepted platform snapshot.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Source contract, build and production cold-route timing show no supplier request in the page critical path.

predicted_rejections.rejection: New-tab navigation bypasses every prefetch and still feels slow.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Warm both App Router data and the browser document cache for business-depth destinations.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Intent events issue both router prefetch and a cacheable same-origin document warmup.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Performance work breaks galleries, search, home or event pages.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run focused affected-family tests, full build and fresh desktop/mobile public flows.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Home, search, business, event and spa routes render and navigate correctly after deployment.

sources.label: Public media must use approved real assets and no broken placeholder card may ship
Supplier refresh is separated from the public read path

midpoint_gate.trigger: Focused media and navigation contracts pass before the production build.
checks: all-failed media withdraws its deal card
accepted snapshots replace live supplier calls
new-tab detail targets receive document warmup
primary business media is high priority

attack_questions: Can one failed image still leave an empty card shell?
Can any public business or event page still call the supplier live?
Does the new-tab policy prevent warming on touch or pointer intent?
Do cold, R2 and memory-cache paths all remain truthful?
Does mobile render real media without layout breakage?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Fresh production timings and screenshots for home, search, business and spa surfaces after the deployed release becomes active.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full build, release identity and desktop/mobile production checks.

effectiveness.baseline: A supplied spa card renders a large unavailable-image panel; browser-like cold business HTML was measured near two seconds and detail rendering could wait up to twelve seconds on a live supplier call.
effectiveness.target: No empty media card ships, no live supplier call blocks public detail rendering, and representative warmed public navigations score at least 9/10.
